items.source: NOTE: MongoDB Java Driver 5.7+ comes with observability directly built in which can be configured via MongoClientSettings.Builder#observabilitySettings(ObservabilitySettings). We recommend switching to the driver native observability.
items.translation: 注意：MongoDB Java 驱动程序 5.7 及以上版本内置了可观测性功能，可通过 MongoClientSettings.Builder#observabilitySettings(ObservabilitySettings) 进行配置。我们建议使用驱动程序原生的可观测性功能。

items.source: Create a new MongoObservationCommandListener to record Observations. This constructor attaches the ConnectionString to every Observation and uses the given MongoHandlerObservationConvention.
items.translation: 创建一个新的MongoObservationCommandListener以记录Observation。此构造函数将ConnectionString附加到每个Observation，并使用给定的MongoHandlerObservationConvention。

items.source: since 5.1 in favor of native MongoDB Java Driver observability support.
items.translation: 自 5.1 版本起，支持原生 MongoDB Java Driver 的可观测性。
